videos.title: ITS, Eliza & MiT's AI Lab - Computerphile
videos.author: Computerphile
videos.description:
ITS is the Incompatible Timesharing System. Academics at the MIT AI Lab didn't like earlier incarnations of time-sharing so they invented their own.

Lars Brinkhoff and Oscar Vermeulen explain and demonstrate this segment of Computing history which they've worked to bring back in simulation for ever
